column1: # expectation was obtained by running both engines and requiring them
# A member is reached by a cover whose trial admits the value; every
# member none reaches must meet t, which nil refuses.
# A scalar has no members, so every rest admits it.
# A record's keys is a schema each reached key meets, a list index read
# as its digits; prefix reaches the list members below it, and no key of
# a map; items reaches the members its schema admits.
# A trial reads the value by the admission trial: a record applies where
# its trial admits, the else record where it refuses, and nested covers
# only where their own record applies.
# Atoms with one canon are one check, and the pairs sort by canon.
# Members are those generation emits: an optional key the value lacks
# is none, and one generation fills is one.
# A rest inside a trial decides the trial.

column3: a: nof(1, {x: any} & rest(nil, any, {keys: "x"})) & {x: 1, y: 2}
